analyzed_vuln.description: `concat_hash_string` performs multiple 32-bit length reads from `packet->payload` (starting at fixed offset 22) before ensuring at least 4 bytes remain. The first read `ntohl(*(u_int32_t*)&packet->payload[offset])` and later similar reads can occur when `offset` is already near/end of payload, causing out-of-bounds heap read. Validation is done too late/incompletely (checks often happen after reading `len`, and not consistently before every `u_int32_t` fetch).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `fuzz_ndpi_reader`, packets are copied into an exact-size heap buffer (`malloc(header->caplen)`), so any parser overread is detected. Trigger requires SSH flow reaching `ndpi_search_ssh_tcp` key-exchange path (`msgcode == 20`), which calls `concat_hash_string` with attacker-controlled payload length/content. A truncated/malformed SSH KEXINIT payload with insufficient bytes at/after offset 22 causes the 4-byte length load to read past the end of `packet_checked`, producing the ASan heap-buffer-overflow.
